candidate.title: Key 8 - Reasoning AI Models: O3, Claude Thinking & Chain of Thought
candidate.description:
A new generation of AI models can “think” before responding. Discover how reasoning models like OpenAI’s O3, Claude with extended thinking, and Gemini’s think mode use chain-of-thought prompting, self-reflection, and multiple attempt strategies to solve complex logic puzzles and multi-step problems that stumped earlier models.

Key concepts covered:

- Traditional LLMs (instant answers) vs. reasoning models (thoughtful responses)
- Chain-of-thought: showing step-by-step work like solving math problems
- Self-reflection: models reviewing and improving their own answers
- Multiple attempts: sampling low-probability solution paths simultaneously
- Real examples: 12-coin puzzle, Einstein’s five-house problem
- Trade-offs: slower and more expensive, but much better at complex reasoning

Other videos in this series:
After mastering Understanding AI & LLMs (Parts 2): Exploring Models, continue to the Eisenhower AI Decision Matrix: When to Use AI (Time vs Stakes) video for practical AI decision-making guidance. Watch the full playlist for complete AI understanding.

Who this is for: Researchers, data scientists, and professionals working with complex problem-solving tasks requiring logic, planning, or multi-step reasoning capabilities.
